messages:
Sam Wilson: Quick summary — after last night's regional failover game day we captured a set of follow-ups. I'm opening this thread to hand off owners and timelines. High level: multi-region routing rules, S3 backup verification, restore runbook gaps, and a repeatable game-day checklist.

Maria Chen: I'll take backups verification. Plan to validate snapshots + cross-region replication. ETA EOW (Fri).

Aj Patel: I'll own routing rules / LB failover policy. Need to coordinate with infra to update health-check thresholds. Can take this, ETA next Wed. @Liam can you help with canary config? :+1:

Liam O'Connor: Yup, I'll help with canary tests. Will add a small test harness to the perf-suite and run it against staging. Target: Tue next week.

Nora Park: I'll update the restore runbook — noticed steps missing around KV cache rebuild and certificate rotation. Will put PR up for review by Thu.

Sam Wilson: Thanks all. Two cross-cutting items: 1) define a measurable success criteria for game-days (target restore < 20m for tier-1), 2) schedule a mini-rehearsal after runbook updates. Who can own the rehearsal scheduling? Calendar invite template: https://calendar.company.com/event/template/dr-rehearsal

Maria Chen: I can schedule the rehearse for the week after runbook PR merges. Will ping on this thread when invite is live.

Aj Patel: For routing policy, I'm proposing: prefer region with lowest latency < 50ms, fallback to warm standby region, and auto-failover after 3 consecutive HC failures. Snippet of current config:
```
lb_policy:
  mode: weighted
  fallback: warm-standby
  hc_threshold: 3
```
Will propose exact values in a PR.

Liam O'Connor: Note: make sure health-check endpoint excludes long-running batch jobs. We saw false positives during game day.

deploy-bot: game-day-run complete — artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-dr/game-day/1945678800/

Sam Wilson: Action items recap (we'll keep this pinned):
- Maria: backups verification — due Fri
- Aj: routing policy + PR — due next Wed
- Liam: canary harness + tests — due Tue
- Nora: restore runbook updates + PR — due Thu
I'll follow up with a short weekly cadence for status. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
